Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons — usage rules
==============================================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons
License: MIT (© Microsoft Corporation 2020)
Trademark: Microsoft Trademark and Brand Guidelines
           https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/intellectualproperty/trademarks/usage/general

While the FluentUI System Icons files themselves are MIT-licensed,
Microsoft brand and product trademarks remain Microsoft's intellectual
property. The MIT license covers redistribution of the icon files; the
trademark layer governs HOW the icons may be used.

Verbatim Don'ts (mirror of Azure / Fabric Microsoft icon rules):
  - Don't crop, flip, or rotate icons.
  - Don't distort or change icon shape in any way.
  - Don't use Microsoft product icons to represent your product or service.

What you SHOULD do:
  - Use FluentUI icons as decorators in architecture diagrams (Cloud,
    Database, Shield, Person, status indicators, etc.) to label users,
    data flow, authentication, and system status alongside Azure / Fabric
    service icons.
  - Always show the concept name as a label adjacent to the icon (this is
    a Microsoft Do — same convention as the Azure Architecture Icons).

This project is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Microsoft
Corporation. The icons are redistributed in unmodified form for use in
software architecture diagrams under the MIT license grant.

This file is the per-vendor USAGE-RULES counterpart to dist/Azure/USAGE-RULES.txt
and dist/Fabric/USAGE-RULES.txt.

For full license text and per-source attribution, see NOTICE at the repository
root.
